correctness.rationale: Both compositions expand exactly as stated and have triangular periodic realizations with multipliers \(e^{-aP}\), \(e^{-bP}\). Positive causal Green inverses and absence of a nonzero bilateral bounded homogeneous solution show that their L-infinity operator norms are sharp Ulam constants. Uniform nondegenerate Laplace estimates at the past source maximum and observation minimum prove the first response peak and pulse mass. A weight bound and a post-pulse test phase give matching bounds for the downstream filter, proving both exact asymptotic prefactors and their positive square-root ratio. value.rationale: Exact stable Floquet spectra and identical mean damping/stiffness do not quantify worst-case forced response. The theorem identifies an unbounded, sharp square-root separation of optimal whole-line Ulam constants under factor reversal, with a nontrivial two-extremum Gaussian mechanism valid for an infinite-dimensional family of smooth periodic modulations. This is a natural robustness distinction beyond abstract existence of best constants or a change of notation.
